title: export_token_transfer turns a text or hash memo into a muxed destination with ID 0
severity_basis: Silent wrong value in a participant-facing field: a muxed address with ID 0 is fabricated from a memo. Executed at the pinned commit; upstream keeps the behaviour on purpose and pins it in a test, so the issue stays open.

entries.expected: no M address is built from a memo; to_muxed_id carries the memo value with its type
entries.observed: Executed at v2.8.34 (2b24ec89) through the replay harness: export_token_transfer writes the self-payment of transaction c31dd894… with to_muxed set to the account's key with muxed ID 0 and to_muxed_id "0", where the event carries the 32 MEMO_HASH bytes; the harness reports routing u64:0 against bytes. The address the bytes would spell is not recorded. Every other compared fact matched.

entries.expected: no M address is built from a memo; to_muxed_id carries the memo value with its type
entries.observed: Executed at v2.8.34 (2b24ec89) through the replay harness: export_token_transfer writes the mint of transaction 6591994c… with to_muxed MBN32NH6…ATXO (the recipient's key with muxed ID 0) and to_muxed_id "0", where the event carries the text "psp:160886906"; the harness reports routing u64:0 against text. Every other compared fact matched (382 transactions, receipts, participants). Upstream keeps the behaviour on purpose and pins it in a test.

entries.expected: no M address is built from a memo; to_muxed_id carries the memo value with its type
entries.observed: Executed at v2.8.34 (2b24ec89) through the replay harness: export_token_transfer writes each of the five transfers of transaction 7f2aaed8… with to_muxed set to the destination's key with muxed ID 0 and to_muxed_id "0", where the events carry the text "Daily 2026-11-12"; the harness reports routing u64:0 against text five times. Every other compared fact matched.

entries.expected: no M address is built from a memo; to_muxed_id carries the memo value with its type
entries.observed: Executed at v2.8.34 (2b24ec89) through the replay harness: the operation-1 transfer to the muxed destination is written correctly (to_muxed_id 23144059716), but the operation-0 self-transfer, whose event carries the text "SoroswapAggregator-5637e5344", is written with to_muxed_id "0" and an M address; the harness reports routing u64:0 against text. Every other compared fact matched.

entries.expected: no muxed address is built from a memo
entries.observed: XDR101 at internal/transform/token_transfer.go:210 and :223 (encodeMuxedDestination): a value from the MuxedInfo_Text arm reaches strkey.MuxedContract.SetID() and strkey.MuxedAccount.SetID() (make lint-stellar-etl)

evidence.pre_fix: stellar-etl v2.8.34 (2b24ec89) through the replay harness with --assert-known: mishandled · wrong_value on four pubnet entries (evidence/stellar-etl/); make lint-stellar-etl (xdrlint built with the Go toolchain stellar-etl requires) reports XDR101 at the two SetID calls in internal/transform/token_transfer.go, suppressed with this record as its finding.
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-67: to_muxed_id is the transaction memo or the muxed ID with its own type; a text or hash memo is not a routing ID.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 6 of 6 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0015.json (returned: reproduction steps: the lint half does not run as written with the kit's linter, and its report path is produced by nothing in the repository).

evidence_added.reason: The issue already describes the behaviour, and upstream pins it in a test on purpose; our entries reproduce exactly what it describes.
